selection_method: Manual design-time audit of non-gold reconstructed threads with clear Spotify response evidence and no reconstruction flags.
canonical_gold_policy: Representative records are excluded from the canonical 200-record gold set.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: Spotify explained that unavailable catalog content can be temporarily removed because of licensing changes and set expectations for possible future availability.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: Sometimes content gets temporarily removed because of licensing changes. Hopefully we'll have them available again soon.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports a concise licensing-based explanation and avoids promising that a specific track will be restored.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: Spotify requested track identifiers, acknowledged a duplicate or incorrect catalog report, and stated that it would be reported for investigation.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: We'll be sure to get this reported. Great detective work!
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports acknowledging concrete metadata evidence and passing the report to content operations without claiming an immediate correction.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: Spotify stated that service availability depended on launch coverage in the customer's country and directed the customer to stay informed about future availability.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: We haven't launched there yet, but hopefully we'll get there soon.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports explaining regional availability without implying that support can override country or licensing restrictions.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: For a repeated-charge report, Spotify requested a private account follow-up so the account and payment history could be checked.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: Could you send us a DM with your account's email address? We'll take a look backstage.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports directing account-specific billing investigations to a secure channel and acknowledging that duplicate charges require account review.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: When asked about pausing a subscription, Spotify explained that the requested pause option was unavailable and described cancellation followed by later resubscription as the available account-management path.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: You can cancel your subscription ... then resubscribe when you're ready.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports giving a direct account-management path while clearly distinguishing available subscription actions from unsupported pause functionality.
representative_conversations.redaction_note: The intervening help URL was removed from the excerpt.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: For a possible account-compromise report, Spotify provided security guidance and redirected sensitive account details away from the public thread into a private channel.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: We'd recommend deleting your last tweet as it contains sensitive account info. You can DM it to us instead.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports combining account-recovery guidance with a secure-channel warning when authentication or compromise concerns are present.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: For an individual playback-control malfunction, Spotify asked for device context, suggested restarting the device, and escalated to a private follow-up after the first troubleshooting step did not resolve the issue.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: Can you try restarting your device ... Keep us posted.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports a progressive troubleshooting sequence: restart, gather device details, and move account-specific investigation to a private channel.
representative_conversations.redaction_note: The device-button details were shortened from the original excerpt.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: For a requested product capability, Spotify acknowledged the idea and directed the customer to the Community for suggestion and user support.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: This sounds like a great idea! Suggest it in our Community and get support from other users.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports acknowledging feature feedback and directing requests to the established ideas channel rather than promising implementation.

representative_conversations.observed_resolution_pattern: For an artist-profile management question, Spotify directed the customer to Spotify for Artists for the relevant profile change instructions.
representative_conversations.evidence_excerpt: You can change your image at any time with Spotify for Artists.
representative_conversations.policy_influence: Supports directing creator and rights-holder workflows to the dedicated Spotify for Artists channel rather than handling them as ordinary listener support.
